bagPolicy.summary: Coors Field enforces a clear bag policy to ensure fan safety and expedite entry. Only specific types and sizes of bags are permitted.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets up to 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets, zippers or concealable areas up to 18” wide
prohibited: Luggage, computer bags, camera bags, briefcases, fanny packs, cinch bags
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are exceptions.

parking.note: Coors Field is in Denver's LoDo district with Rockies-operated lots near the ballpark plus numerous downtown garages and surface lots within walking distance. Prepaid parking is available through the team and SpotHero; rates rise for marquee games. Light rail and the Free MallRide are convenient alternatives.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Coors Field's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Coors Field offers a variety of food and beverage options, including classic comfort foods with bold flavors and modern twists. Highlights include specialty items like Bacon Wrapped Hot Dogs, Pastrami Fries, and indulgent Milkshakes. Fans can enjoy local and popular beers at the Beer Garden.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Coors Field, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Coors Field's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Coors Field Ticket Office Hours Since tickets retrieved within the MLB Ballpark app will now be considered printed, the tickets will not be available for pickup at Will Call.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Coors Field is accessible through all five entry gates (A-E).
